name: s3g NIM BU16 2 - Upper Right
description: No Input Mixer matrix: MIDI channel 2, notes 0-15, native strike Note On followed by polyphonic pressure. Signed feedback fades orange for positive and cyan for negative. Destinations 1-4; sources 5-8.
